notes: Downloads and update checks now come from the GitHub releases of turpin-studio/sequent-bridge, where the code is public under the Eclipse Public License 2.0.
Lets the studio's apps on turpin.studio subdomains, such as midi.turpin.studio, connect.
Uses next to no power when idle: it no longer redraws its menu-bar icon every second whether or not anything has changed.
Comes as a disk image only; the zip has gone.

Says in its menu when a newer version is out, with a link to the download page. It asks turpin.studio which version is the latest when it starts and twice a day, and sends nothing about you or your decks.
Shows its version in the menu bar drop-down, above About Sequent.
Signed and notarised by Apple, so it opens like any downloaded app: no more Privacy and Security, Open Anyway.
Reads each CDJ-3000X's key, Key Shift included, from the deck itself, so the page follows the key without a rekordbox lookup.
Shows each CDJ's model and firmware in the page's deck list.
--capture, run from Terminal, records a deck's status packets when something reads wrong.
About Sequent in the menu, with the version and a credit to Deep Symmetry's DJ Link research.
Tells the Sequent page its version, shown on the transport's CDJ row.
Credits Deep Symmetry, whose published research it decodes the CDJs with.
Comes as a disk image: open it and drag Sequent into Applications.
First release: a menu-bar app that listens to CDJs over Pro DJ Link and passes their tempo, beats and tracks to the Sequent page.
